text:
sam_marketing: Quick heads-up — EU partial routing degradation reported by infra. Ops estimates brief intermittent errors for ~10-20m. We need marketing coordination: statuspage copy, hold/adjust tomorrow's benchmark narrative, and routing for webinar signups. Thoughts?

ops-bot: Incident created: EU routing partial degradation (INC-20260301). Priority: high. Link: http://incident.example/INC-20260301

elaine_prodops: Confirmed. Mitigation in progress, will push config rollback in ~12m. Agree hold public benchmark post until resolved. Draft status page below:

```
Status: Degraded — Partial routing issues in EU region affecting a subset of inference requests.
Impact: Some requests may see errors or timeouts; not all customers affected.
What we’re doing: Mitigating via rollback and traffic re-route; monitoring closely.
ETA: Next update in 15 minutes.
```

rachael_cust_ops: Suggest we hold external post until we see "Mitigated" or after 30m stable. Prepare two short customer messages: (1) acknowledgement + high-level impact, (2) resolved follow-up. I’ll request FR/DE translations once copy locked.

tom_growth: For webinar signups: route leads to `webinar-standby` SDR list and tag as `inc-affected`. Pause the automated nurture send for 24h and flag the cohort — we don’t want churn from confusing comms. @sam_marketing can you confirm?

miguel_oncall: Rolled back routing change at :45, saw error rate drop ~40%. Still seeing KV cache warmup causing occasional 5xxs; watching. Will post metrics when error rate <1%.

sam_marketing: Ok locking copy and pausing the benchmark tweet + benchmarking blog launch. Also will hold the launch email send. Who can help with translations? @rachael_cust_ops?

rachael_cust_ops: On it — pinging translation vendor now for FR/DE. Also drafting a very short statuspage-friendly customer email template (subject + 3 bullets) to drop here in ~10m.

sam_marketing: Template ask: 2-line subject + 3 bullets (impact, what we’re doing, expected ETA). I’ll draft initial social-safe language once you post the template.

miguel_oncall: New metrics: error spike peaked at :47, now trending down. No need for expanded customer escalation at this point.

elaine_prodops: ETA next update 10m. If error rate steadies <=0.5% for two consecutive 5m windows we mark mitigated.

sam_marketing: Thanks team — holding socials, routing leads to `webinar-standby`, translations queued, nurture paused. I’ll post the locked copy here when ready. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 15 minutes for INC-20260301.
